findings: Both capacity branches retain PW+1 bits. Early subtraction truncation commutes with the final modular addition for binary inputs, including all overfull pointer values and read_count5..7.
Unsigned PW+1-bit branch comparison against4 matches the prior truncated space_after_retire comparison. Original space_after_retire remains present; only ring_overflow_now selects the new predicate.
Generated resident_tag and resident_verdict are continuous wire aliases of the same constant-index elements, preserving unknown slot values as well as binary values.
Only those aliases replace the first effective_tag/next_value read. New-slot selection, four ordered verdict writes and their priorities are otherwise byte-identical.

All cache/state write gates, no-reset arrays, reset/flush pointers and output-valid quarantine remain byte-identical. When inactive/aborting, the unchanged enabled/active/step guards prevent dormant cache values from committing.
limitations: Binary capacity comparison is not arbitrary four-state equivalence. With retire=X and equal definite branch comparisons, the new conditional can resolve where arithmetic using an unknown increment was X-pessimistic. No such extra four-state claim is made.
The correctness of exposing only initialized committed slots remains the inherited ring/cache invariant; this source review does not newly prove that whole design invariant.
No source or test edits were made, and author HDL control outcomes are not counted as independently rerun evidence.
scope: Exact generated/inverse source bridges plus independent integer arithmetic. No HDL test execution, simulator, all-state formal proof, physical timing or native replay.
